verdict.rationale: Highnote's API explicitly supports agent-driven card issuance, spend rules/velocity controls, and real-time ledger/balance visibility, and its agentic-commerce docs frame these as designed for agents to operate programmatically (docs-17 to docs-21, docs-1/2/3). However there is no evidence of an MCP surface, and credential scoping is described only as 'one key, one endpoint' rather than granular per-agent scoped credentials. Missing for 10: MCP server/tool surface, explicit per-agent scoped API credentials, independent/hands-on corroboration of agent-driven usage.
